pages.text: Under each main base a stair leads to a portal hall. The portal is dark while its guards live: kill them and step in to reach the sky ship.
Kerrigan in the leviathan, Raynor on the Hyperion, Artanis in the mothership. At 2/3 health a hero calls its guard; at 1/3 it rages. Reward: a full suit, 16 shards, 8 diamonds.
